task: Functional hyperemia (the BOLD-fMRI basis): neural activity -> neurovascular unit (neuron-astrocyte-arteriole) signalling -> local CBF rise that OUTPACES the local CMRO2 rise -> deoxyhemoglobin concentration falls -> positive BOLD. Quantitative model = Buxton-Wong-Frank (1998) balloon-model ODE, parametrized entirely from independently-measured literature (Grubb/Ito CBV-CBF exponent, Fox&Raichle/Davis/Hoge CBF:CMRO2 ratios, Boynton/Filosa onset timing), forced through a flow-matches-metabolism-1:1 adversary and an external (Leithner 2010) empirical cross-check. NOT cerebral autoregulation (pressure-flow; separate cert, `docs/MECHANISM_CEREBRAL_AUTOREGULATION.md`).
confidence_tier: TIERED, not uniform -- (1) HIGHEST: the n_ratio=1 geometric identity (analytically proven, sec.1/6 of the doc) and the Leithner et al. 2010 empirical cross-check (external paper, zero parameters fit to it, sec.10) -- non-circular, machine-verified. (2) STRONG: three independently-measured CBF:CMRO2 mismatch ratios (PET + 2 calibrated-BOLD labs, sec.8) and the Grubb-exponent sensitivity (0.38 vs 0.29, sec.11), both cross-method-corroborated. (3) WEAKEST, disclosed: the undershoot's specific tau_m=3x multiplier (a licensed-but-not-independently-fit choice, sec.7) and the ion-channel-level mechanism narrative (cited reviews/primary papers, not independently re-derived, sec.5), plus one genuinely unresolved controversy (astrocyte-Ca2+ requirement, Nizar 2013 vs Mulligan/MacVicar 2004 and Metea/Newman 2006, held OPEN not force-resolved).

geometric_falsifier_proof.claim: if m(t) == f_in(t) for all t (flow matches metabolism exactly, n_ratio=1) and q(0)=v(0) (true at rest), then q(t) == v(t) for ALL t, for ANY alpha, tau0, or driving profile shape
geometric_falsifier_proof.proof: let w=q-v; dw/dt = dq/dt - dv/dt = [m(t) - v^(1/alpha-1)*q - f_in(t) + v^(1/alpha)]/tau0 = v^(1/alpha-1)*(v-q)/tau0 = -v(t)^(1/alpha-1)/tau0 * w(t) (the m(t)-f_in(t) terms cancel exactly when m==f_in); this is a linear homogeneous ODE in w with w(0)=0, hence w(t)=0 for all t by uniqueness
geometric_falsifier_proof.significance: the n_ratio=1 adversary is not merely attenuated in this model -- it is EXACTLY null by the model's own geometric structure, independent of any specific parameter choice

overall_verdict: PASS -- 9/9 MACHINE-COMPUTED pre-registered gates pass (the literal contents of results['gates'] in reports/probes/neurovascular_coupling_results.json, see falsifier_gates + doc sec.15), including one analytically-proven (not merely numerically-observed) result (the n_ratio=1 geometric identity) and one non-circular external cross-check (Leithner et al. 2010, zero parameters fit to it). The mechanism narrative (sec.5), Alzheimer's anchors (sec.13), and astrocyte-Ca2+ controversy (sec.5/10) are citation-coverage checks, kept deliberately OUT of the 9/9 gate count so a qualitative literature-coverage claim is never counted as a machine-scored boolean (symmetric QC). A forced adversary (Nizar 2013, astrocyte-Ca2+ requirement) is held explicitly OPEN rather than force-resolved, and every free modeling choice (Grubb alpha, Boynton tau/n, the undershoot tau_m multiplier) is disclosed with its own sensitivity check rather than silently asserted.
symmetric_qc_open_items: astrocyte Ca2+ requirement: Nizar et al. 2013 (IP3R2-KO mice show intact vasodilation) directly conflicts with the Ca2+-dependent mechanisms in Mulligan and MacVicar 2004 and Metea and Newman 2006 -- NOT resolved, held open, consistent with Zhu et al. 2022's own characterization of this as contentious in the human literature

the undershoot's tau_m=3x multiplier is a disclosed, literature-licensed but not independently-fit free choice -- the qualitative existence of an undershoot given SOME CBF/CMRO2-recovery asymmetry is well-supported (Buxton 1998 + Chen and Pike 2009), the exact depth is not a precision prediction
Grubb's original alpha=0.38 is provenance-only (pre-abstract-era paper) -- mitigated, not eliminated, by the live Ito 2003 human re-measurement and stability check
the 3 CBF:CMRO2 mismatch ratios used (5.80, 2.81, 1.92) span a real 3x range across methods/eras -- reported as a genuine spread, not force-averaged into a single number
the full k1/k2/k3 BOLD-signal-equation weighting was not implemented (q/v proxy used instead) -- sufficient for this document's sign/magnitude falsifier, not a literal %BOLD predictor
